name: Competitor Pricing Page Diff Tracker (Apify → HubSpot)

parameters.content:
## Competitor Pricing Page Diff Tracker
**Safe by default.** With no env vars set this workflow runs on SYNTHETIC fixtures, writes nothing to HubSpot and sends nothing to Slack.

Live writes need ALL of: `SANDBOX_MODE=false`, `DRY_RUN=false`, `HUBSPOT_LOGGING_ENABLED=true`, `HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `APIFY_API_TOKEN`, `COMPETITOR_TARGETS_JSON`.

Slack needs `SEND_SLACK_ALERTS=true` + `DRY_RUN=false` + `SLACK_PRICING_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL`.

See README.md · DISCLAIMER.md

nodes.name: Apify: Run Pricing Scraper Actor
nodes.notes: Live only. One synchronous actor run per competitor.

nodes.name: Slack: Post RevOps Alert
nodes.notes: Incoming webhook. Only when SEND_SLACK_ALERTS=true and DRY_RUN=false.

nodes.name: Ops: Post Failure Alert
nodes.notes: Only when SEND_OPS_ALERTS=true, DRY_RUN=false and errors/review items exist.
